# WorkBuddy Toolkit

> WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy (Tencent AI Coding Assistant) multi-account manager, automated check-in, Seatbelt sandbox self-healing, and failover routing toolkit.

## Overview
WorkBuddy Toolkit provides zero-touch local automation for WorkBuddy & CodeBuddy users across macOS, Linux, and Windows. It resolves sandbox rule explosions (macOS Seatbelt SBPL O(N^2) compilation deadlocks), enables seamless multi-account credential switching, automates daily check-in with keepalive conversations, and transparently routes AI completions via a local failover proxy (:8047).

## Core Capabilities & CLI Commands
- `workbuddy login [alias]` (`wb-login`): Terminal 1:1 ANSI QR-code independent login without opening the Electron UI.
- `workbuddy switch [alias]` (`wb-switch`): Instant multi-account profile switching in <1s without WeChat re-scanning.
- `workbuddy memory` (`wb-memory`): Aggregate `MEMORY.md` entries across accounts into a shared library, dedupe near-duplicates keeping the higher-quality version (losers archived), and append a managed block to each account without rewriting its current text. Only rules are published (P0 redline / P1 explicit instruction / P2 project convention); habits and inferred facts (P3/P4), entries containing local paths/emails/URLs/UUIDs, and Markdown fragments (lines starting with `>`, `*`, `_`, `|`) never cross accounts. `apply` renders against the account's **current** own content, so deleted lines stay deleted; snapshots only serve `restore`. `rebalance` moves whole `##` sections (when ≥2 headings) into `SOUL.md` / `USER.md` and prints per-section keep/move; `restore` also strips those managed sections. `compact` shards oversized or habit/fact entries into `cache/shared_memory/shards/<id>.md` and injects at most 8 index lines (shard text itself is never injected). Rendered output stays within the 4000-char window with the account's own text first. Default shared-block budget is 800 chars (`apply --budget N`). Subcommands: `collect` / `compact [--shard-min N]` / `apply [account]` / `rebalance [--apply]` / `forget <keyword> [--apply]` / `conflicts` / `status` / `restore <account>` / `on` / `off`; snapshots under `cache/shared_memory/originals/`, backups under `cache/shared_memory/backups/`, shards under `cache/shared_memory/shards/`.
- `workbuddy checkin` (`wb-checkin`): Automated silent daily check-in and low-cost/free model conversation keepalive.
- `workbuddy status` / `list` (`wb-status` / `wb-list`): Account inventory, token expiry inspection, and JSON output for agents.
- `workbuddy doctor` (`wb-doctor`): Inspect credential encryption (Suite 1 / $wbEncrypted), runtime compatibility, and Seatbelt rule health.
- `workbuddy doctor --inspect-137`: Forensic fingerprinting and failure classification (Families A~H) for shell exit 137 (SIGKILL).
- `workbuddy sandbox heal` (`wb-sandbox heal`): Inject wildcard rules via Unix Domain Socket IPC to collapse bloated rulesets (17,500+ down to 48).
- `workbuddy sandbox clean` (`wb-sandbox clean`): C-FFI (libproc) based orphan daemon harvester with active user process protection.
- `workbuddy router` (`wb-router`): Local multi-protocol failover gateway (:8047) supporting DeepSeek, Hunyuan, and custom model routing.

## Quick Setup for AI Agents
```bash
git clone https://github.com/FlapPearLabs/workbuddy-toolkit.git ~/.workbuddy/toolkit
cd ~/.workbuddy/toolkit && python3 install.py --no-input   # CLI only; add --with-checkin etc. only after the user confirms
workbuddy doctor
```
